name: io.github.m00nreport/mcp-server
title: M00N Report
description: Test management over MCP: author cases, run manual executions, cut releases, read health

environmentVariables.name: M00N_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your M00N Report URL. Root origin, no /api suffix.

environmentVariables.name: M00N_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: An MCP key from Settings. Anything without the m00n_mcp_ prefix is refused before the first request.

environmentVariables.name: M00N_DEBUG
environmentVariables.description: Adds per-request detail to stderr, including each tool call's arguments.

environmentVariables.name: M00N_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Request timeout in milliseconds. A bare number; anything else falls back to the default.

environmentVariables.name: M00N_INSECURE_SSL
environmentVariables.description: Accept a self-signed certificate. Self-hosted instances only.
